# Field Track

> A held MVP for managers to review fresh locations and retained routes from administrator-enrolled Android phones.

## Product

- [Interactive synthetic demo](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/): The real manager dashboard with fictional employees and routes
- [Markdown brief](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product, tracking boundary, proof, and lifecycle

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/api/ai)
- [OpenAPI description](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/openapi.json)
- [Sitemap](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://field-track.sassmaker.com/robots.txt)

## Important boundary

Administrator-enrolled devices track continuously without employee start, stop, pause, or unenroll controls. Android keeps its ongoing location notification visible. The public site contains synthetic data only; economics and physical Android validation remain open.
